notes: Only completed trials are scanned; all measured costs use frozen comparison rates.
Repack observations are correlated with cache misses; no provider internal cache trace is available.
Main calls without usage are excluded here and remain unknown in the primary audit.
A changed dropped-item set is a context edit, not proof of which token caused a cache miss.
progress_to_packed includes local context preparation and synchronous compaction; it is not a tokenizer profiler.
packed_to_usage includes request setup, model execution and response parsing; it is not pure provider latency.
